The same at least six of eight real groups must have positive flag coefficients with 95% engine-bootstrap CIs excluding zero for BOTH median squared error and Brier after the specified RUL adjustment. Synthetic confirmation requires positive adjusted flag AND distance coefficients, with 95% CIs excluding zero, for BOTH squared oracle probability deviation and mean absolute oracle quantile deviation in BOTH families. Family-level effects are the equally weighted mean of the eight temporal subset/architecture coefficients or four covariate subset coefficients, using weighted-raw, final-window, 10,000-engine settings only. Bootstrap draws share engine resamples within each subset across architectures/variants, independently across subsets. Every individual setting is also reported; no choice of favorable settings. Rank-deficient required components fail the rule. If either real or synthetic condition fails, report "not informative" under this rule. No subgroup search or post-result revision.

Synthetic confirmation uses equally weighted family-level coefficients from weighted-raw final-window evaluation on 10000 engines per subset. Required unidentifiable effects fail the rule under the numerical addendum.
